Criterion: Verify that air start requirements are met and documented in the flight manual. Air starts include spool-down, windmill, cross-bleed and starter-assisted as appropriate for the air vehicle system. Standard: Airstart capability is documented in the flight manual. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include test and review of documentation. The airstart envelope is initially verified from ground testing in altitude test cells and then verified by flight test. References: JSSG-2007: A.3.2.2.3.2, A.4.2.2.3.2; A.4.11.1.2 (Altitude test) 14 CFR 33.69 (Ignitions system); 33.89 Operation test

Standard: Defined air start envelopes (e.g., spool-down, windmill, cross-bleed, starter assisted) meet air vehicle’s intended operational needs. Air start capability is documented in the flight manual. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review of documentation (e.g., ICD) verifies defined air start envelopes meet air vehicle’s intended operational needs.
(2) Review of flight manual validates air start envelopes. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Ground-based altitude cell tests verify air start capability meets envelopes. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: In-flight tests verify capability meets envelopes.
